rows.grounds: Fused form: agnaye (to Agni) + vāmataḥ (on the left); indicates the deity and position for the oblation.
Fused form: somāya (to Soma) + iti (thus/so saying); marks the second deity invoked by the mantra.
Instrument by which the oblation is performed.
Prescribes the ritual act of oblation.

items.question: Which deities and mantra are prescribed for performing the oblation in this ritual arrangement?
premises: The oblation is directed to Agni on the left.
The oblation is directed to Soma as indicated by the mantra.
The act of offering is to be performed using a mantra.
items.inference: Therefore, one should perform the oblation with the mantra, addressing Agni on the left and Soma.
uncertainties: The exact wording of the mantra referred to by iti is not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: One should offer the oblation with the mantra, addressing Agni on the left and Soma.
